instantaneous-power-dot-product.title: Instantaneous Power
instantaneous-power-dot-product.interpretation: Power defines the instantaneous rate of work performance. It quantifies the energy flux into a system as the projection of the force vector onto the velocity vector.
instantaneous-power-dot-product.symmetry_origin: Power is the time derivative of the Work-Energy identity. It reflects the local temporal rate of change of the system's state in the configuration manifold.
instantaneous-power-dot-product.limits_and_boundary: Zero for 'workless' forces (magnetic Lorentz force, normal force) where the force is strictly orthogonal to motion. At relativistic scales, \( P = dE/dt \) where E is total energy.

poisson-bracket-conservation-78ec4617.title: Canonical Conservation (Poisson Bracket)
poisson-bracket-conservation-78ec4617.interpretation: Determines the stationarity of a dynamical variable within phase space, identifying it as a constant of the motion.
poisson-bracket-conservation-78ec4617.symmetry_origin: The symplectic geometry of phase space where the charge $ serves as the generator of the symmetry transformation.
poisson-bracket-conservation-78ec4617.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to the requirement that the charge must commute with the Hamiltonian in the operator formalism.

comoving-entropy-density-conservation-df.title: Entropy Density Conservation
comoving-entropy-density-conservation-df.interpretation: Describes the conservation of entropy in a comoving volume as the universe expands, providing a stable baseline for measuring the evolution of particle asymmetries.
comoving-entropy-density-conservation-df.symmetry_origin: The adiabatic nature of the cosmic expansion in the absence of massive dissipative forces.
comoving-entropy-density-conservation-df.limits_and_boundary: Ensures that the baryon-to-entropy ratio remains a conserved record of the baryogenesis era.

magnetic-force-decomposition-ident-af22f.title: Magnetic Force Decomposition
magnetic-force-decomposition-ident-af22f.interpretation: Decomposes the total magnetic force into the gradient of magnetic pressure (first term) and the magnetic tension force (second term).
magnetic-force-decomposition-ident-af22f.symmetry_origin: Vector calculus identities combined with Ampère's Law in the absence of displacement currents.
magnetic-force-decomposition-ident-af22f.limits_and_boundary: Reveals that magnetic fields act both to push the gas (pressure) and to resist shearing (tension).

uncertainty-principle-identity-1-1417ded.title: Robertson Uncertainty Relation
uncertainty-principle-identity-1-1417ded.interpretation: States that the product of the standard deviations of any two self-adjoint operators is bounded by half the expectation value of their commutator.
uncertainty-principle-identity-1-1417ded.symmetry_origin: Derived from the algebraic structure of Hilbert spaces and the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality.
uncertainty-principle-identity-1-1417ded.limits_and_boundary: In the limit where operators commute, the lower bound vanishes, permitting simultaneous precise measurement.
